question: True or false: months after watching a series, people who had binged it remembered it better than weekly viewers?
answer: False. In a University of Melbourne study, binge viewers recalled the most just after finishing, but their memory faded fastest; 140 days later, those who had spaced the episodes out remembered more, and had enjoyed the show more too. Spacing gives the brain several chances to store a story.
move: Spread out what you want to keep; cram only what you need tomorrow.
ask: Is there something I hope to keep in my head that I am cramming instead of spreading out?
trap: More hours at once should mean the story sinks in deeper.
reference: Jared Cooney Horvath et al., The impact of binge watching on memory and perceived comprehension, First Monday, 2017
